newsitem.title: USA: IDM sees FY96, 97 revs of $150 mln-$160 mln.
newsitem.headline: IDM sees FY96, 97 revs of $150 mln-$160 mln.

text.p: IDM Environmental Corp said on Monday it expects aggregate revenues in the range of $150 million to $160 million for the combined 1996 and 1997 fiscal years.
IDM, which posted third-quarter results earlier today, said the outlook for the company was "even better than our original expectations."
In a written statement, the company said it expects to commence a number of large projects and to close on several new contracts early in 1997.
IDM also said its board of directors has authorized the repurchase of stock in an amount up to $750,000.

The company reported a third-quarter loss of $3.6 million, or $0.41 per share on revenues of $2.9 million. This compares with net income of $19,000, or $0.00 per share, on revenues of $14.2 million during the third quarter of 1995.
IDM said the quarterly results were hurt by delays in several large projects and significant increases in services on two large government projects that occurred late in the quarter.
IDM Environmental handles industrial plant relocation and re-erection projects. It also provides full-service, turnkey, environmental remediation and plant decommissioning services.
